title: IVG  Air Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: The IVG Air Prefilled Vape Pods are the perfect accompaniment for your IVG Air Pod Kits. Designed to work seamlessly with the IVG Air 2 In 1 and IVG Air 4 In 1 pod kits, these prefilled pods bring the ultimate convenience and satisfaction to your IVG Air. With up to 600 puffs per pod, you can enjoy a long-lasting and fulfilling vape, similar to a standard disposable. These pods are specifically designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, delivering a smooth, tactile draw and rapid nicotine relief. Using the IVG Air Pro pods with your IVG 2 in 1 or 4 in 1 kit is easy. Simply remove the mouthpiece of your kit, insert the pods and replace the mouthpiece to get started. Each pod comes with its own built-in mesh coil for maximum taste and to keep your device in perfect condition. When your pod is empty simply remove it and replace it with a new one. Enjoy the cool and refreshing taste of Strawberry Watermelon, perfect for a fresh and fruity vaping experience. And when you fancy changing up your IVG Air’s flavours, choose from a collection of 27 premium IVG flavours that include fruits, menthols, and beverage flavours and many unique blends found nowhere else.
